01

“Ta Ha. We have not sent down to you the Qur'an that you be…”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 20:2).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
Ta Ha. We have not sent down to you the Qur'an that you be distressed [Ta Ha 2] meaning: "in prayer." It is like His words: "so recite what is easy of it." He said: "They used to hang ropes on their chests during prayer."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
طه مَا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْقُرْآنَ لِتَشْقَى [طه: 2] ، يَعْنِي: «فِي الصَّلَاةِ» . وَهُوَ كَقَوْلِهِ: فَاقْرَءُوا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ، قَالَ: «وَكَانُوا يُعَلِّقُونَ الْحِبَالَ بِصُدُورِهِمْ فِي الصَّلَاةِ»
Edition record 372694 · p. 460Link to report ↗
02
Report from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, he said:
"The secret is what you conceal from people, and 'what is more hidden' meaning the whispering."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
" السِّرُّ: الَّذِي تُسِرُّهُ مِنَ النَّاسِ، وَأَخْفَى " يَعْنِي الْوَسْوَسَةَ
Edition record 372695 · p. 460Link to report ↗
02

“He knows the secret and what is more hidden”

An explanation transmitted from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr (Q 20:7).

03
Explanation from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr 03

Saʿīd ibn Jubayr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ata ibn al-Sa'ib, from Said ibn Jubayr, on His words:
He knows the secret and what is more hidden [Ta Ha 7] he said: "The secret is what you conceal in yourself, and 'more hidden' means what you have not yet spoken to yourself about."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
يَعْلَمُ السِّرَّ وَأَخْفَى [طه: 7] قَالَ: " السِّرُّ: مَا أَسْرَرْتَ فِي نَفْسِكَ، وَأَخْفَى يَعْنِي: مَا لَمْ تُحَدِّثْ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ "
Edition record 372696 · p. 460Link to report ↗

04

“Tuwa”

An explanation transmitted from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr (Q 20:12).

05
Explanation from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr 05

Saʿīd ibn Jubayr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Said ibn Jubayr, on His words:
Tuwa [Ta Ha 12], he said: He says: "Tread the earth barefoot, as you enter the Kaba barefoot, because of the blessing of the valley."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
طُوًى [طه: 12] ، قَالَ: يَقُولُ: " طَأِ الْأَرْضَ حَافِيًا كَمَا تَدْخُلُ الْكَعْبَةَ حَافِيًا: مِنْ بَرَكَةِ الْوَادِي "
Edition record 372698 · p. 460Link to report ↗

Explanation from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr 07

Saʿīd ibn Jubayr

English
Transmission wording

I almost conceal it [Ta Ha 15] "that is, from myself." Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, the like of it.
العربية
الإسناد

Explanation from Mujāhid 09

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording

English

10

“and untie the knot from my tongue”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 20:27).

12
Explanation from Mujāhid 12

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words, Mighty and Majestic:
and untie the knot from my tongue [Ta Ha 27] he said: "an impediment from a burning coal he put in his mouth, at the instance of Pharaoh's wife, who was averting Pharaoh's punishment from him when Moses, a small child who did not understand, took hold of Pharaoh's beard. Pharaoh said: 'This is an enemy of mine.' His wife said: 'He does not understand.'"
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ عز وجل:
وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِنْ لِسَانِي [طه: 27] قَالَ: " عُجْمَةً لِجَمْرَةِ نَارٍ أَدْخَلَهَا فِي فِيهِ عَنْ أَمْرِ امْرَأَةٍ فِرْعَوْنَ تَدْرَأُ عَنْهُ عُقُوبَةَ فِرْعَوْنَ حِينَ أَخَذَ مُوسَى بِلِحْيَةِ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهُوَ صَغِيرٌ لَا يَعْقِلُ، فَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ: هَذَا عَدُوٌّ لِي، فَقَالَتِ امْرَأَتُهُ: إِنَّهُ لَا يَعْقِلُ "
Edition record 372705 · p. 462Link to report ↗
11

“and We saved you from distress”

Three explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 20:40).

13
Explanation from Mujāhid 13

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
and We saved you from distress [Ta Ha 40], he said: "meaning from the distress of killing a person."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
فَنَجَّيْنَاكَ مِنَ الْغَمِّ [طه: 40] ، قَالَ: «يَعْنِي مِنْ غَمِّ قَتْلِ النَّفْسِ»
Edition record 372706 · p. 462Link to report ↗
14
Explanation from Mujāhid 14

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
and We tried you with a [severe] trial [Ta Ha 40] he said: "meaning the affliction: his being cast into the chest, then into the sea, then Pharaoh's household picking him up, then his leaving the city fearing pursuit, afraid and watchful."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَفَتَنَّاكَ فُتُونَا [طه: 40] قَالَ: " يَعْنِي الْبَلَاءَ: إِلْقَاؤُهُ فِي التَّابُوتِ، ثُمَّ فِي الْبَحْرِ، ثُمَّ الْتِقَاطُ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِيَّاهُ، ثُمَّ خُرُوجُهُ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةَ يَخْشَى الطَّلَبَ خَائِفًا يَتَرَقَّبُ "

“who gave each thing its form”

18
Explanation from Mujāhid 18

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording

who gave each thing its form [Ta Ha 50] he said: "He fashioned the creation of every animal"; then guided [Ta Ha 50] He says: "guided it to what suits it and taught it that."

22

“and he produced for them a calf, a body that had a lowing”

Two explanations transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās and Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 20:88).

32
Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās 32

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Hammad ibn Salama related to us, from Simak ibn Harb, from Said ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, on His words:
and he produced for them a calf, a body that had a lowing [Ta Ha 88] he said: "Aaron ﷺ passed by al-Samiri while he was making the calf and said to him: 'What are you making?' He said: 'I am making what neither harms nor benefits.' Aaron said: 'O God, give him what he asks, according to what is in his heart.' When Aaron turned away, al-Samiri said: 'O God, I ask You that it lows,' and it lowed. When it lowed they prostrated and when it lowed they raised their heads. It lowed only because of Aaron's supplication."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
فَأَخْرَجَ لَهُمْ عِجْلًا جَسَدًا لَهُ خُوَارٌ [طه: 88] قَالَ: " مَرَّ هَارُونُ عليه السلام بِالسَّامِرِيِّ وَهُوَ يَصْنَعُ الْعِجْلَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ: مَا تَصْنَعُ؟ قَالَ: أَصْنَعُ مَا يَضُرُّ وَلَا يَنْفَعُ، قَالَ هَارُونُ: اللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِهِ مَا سَأَلَكَ عَلَى مَا فِي نَفْسِهِ، فَلَمَّا قَفَا هَارُونُ، قَالَ السَّامِرِيُّ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ يَخُورَ، فَخَارَ، فَكَانَ إِذَا خَارَ سَجَدُوا، وَإِذَا خَارَ رَفَعُوا رُءُوسَهُمْ، وَإِنَّمَا خَارَ لِدَعْوَةِ هَارُونَ "
Edition record 372725 · p. 465Link to report ↗

فَنَسِيَ [طه: 88] ، يَعْنِي: " مُوسَى عليه السلام نَسِيَ قَوْمَهُ، يَقُولُونَ: أَخْطَأَ الرَّبُّ، أَيِ الْعِجْلَ، نَسِيَهُ عِنْدَكُمْ، قَالَ: وَالْعِجْلُ وَلَدُ الْبَقَرَةِ "

“and We found not in him determination”

44
Explanation from Abū Umāma 44

Abū Umāma al-Bāhilī

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Abu Fudala al-Faraj ibn Fudala related to us, from Luqman ibn Amir, from Abu Umama al-Bahili, who said:
"If the forbearance of all the children of Adam were gathered and placed in one pan of the scale, and the forbearance of Adam in the other, the forbearance of Adam would outweigh theirs." God, Mighty and Majestic, says: and We found not in him determination [Ta Ha 115].
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا أَبُو فَضَالَةَ الْفَرَجُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، عَنْ لُقْمَانَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ الْبَاهِلِيِّ، قَالَ:
«لَوْ أَنَّ أَحْلَامَ بَنِي آدَمَ، كُلِّهِمْ جُمِعَتْ فَجُعِلَتْ فِي كِفَّةٍ وَحُلْمُ آدَمَ فِي كِفَّةٍ لَرَجَحَ حُلْمُ آدَمَ أَحْلَامَهُمْ» . يَقُولُ اللَّهُ عز وجل: وَلَمْ نَجِدْ لَهُ عَزْمًا [طه: 115]

32

“then whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray nor suffer”

Two explanations transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās and Abū Hurayra (Q 20:123).

45
Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās 45

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ata ibn al-Sa'ib, from Abu al-Duha, from Ibn Abbas, on the words of God, Mighty and Majestic:
then whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray nor suffer [Ta Ha 123] He says: "Whoever reads the Qur'an and follows what is in it, God will guide him from error and protect him from the evil of the reckoning." That is because God, Mighty and Majestic, says: then whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray nor suffer [Ta Ha 123].
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ عز وجل:
فَمَنِ اتَّبَعَ هُدَايَ فَلَا يَضِلُّ وَلَا يَشْقَى [طه: 123] يَقُولُ: «مَنْ قَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ وَاتَّبَعَ مَا فِيهِ هَدَاهُ اللَّهُ مِنَ الضَّلَالَةِ وَوَقَاهُ سُوءَ الْحِسَابِ» . وَذَلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ عز وجل يَقُولُ: فَمَنِ اتَّبَعَ هُدَايَ فَلَا يَضِلُّ وَلَا يَشْقَى [طه: 123]
